name: Strength
summary: Heavy compound lifts, 3–6 reps, long rest. Build raw force.

name: Hypertrophy
summary: 6–15 reps close to failure. Build muscle size and shape.

name: Calisthenics
summary: Bodyweight mastery and skill progressions. Train anywhere.

name: HIIT
summary: Short, hard intervals. Conditioning and fat loss in less time.

name: Zone 2 Cardio
summary: Steady, conversational pace. Builds your aerobic engine.

name: Core
summary: Anti-extension, anti-rotation and carries. A stronger trunk.

name: Mobility
summary: Joint range, flexibility and recovery flows.

name: Power & Athletic
summary: Jumps, throws and sprints. Speed and explosiveness.
